_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Directus
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Directus is a headless CMS that turns a database into a REST and GraphQL API with an admin app. The egg runs it on SQLite, with an admin account made on the first start. Its licence is free for organisations under 5 million dollars a year.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Directus and its dependencies"; npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm cache clean --force --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f data/database.db ] && [ -z "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "Set Admin password in the server's settings, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ] || unset ADMIN_PASSWORD; [ -n "${PUBLIC_URL:-}" ] || unset PUBLIC_URL; export HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} PROJECT_OWNER_ENABLED=false; node node_modules/@directus/api/dist/cli/run.js bootstrap || exit 1; node node_modules/@directus/api/dist/cli/run.js start 2>&1 | (trap '' INT TERM; while IFS= read -r l; do printf '%s\n' "$l"; case "$l" in *'shut down OK'*) (sleep 3; kill 0) & ;; esac; done)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Directus: writes the package.json for the chosen Directus version (from
# npm) and a first .env for SQLite, with its own secret. Directus itself is
# installed by npm when the server starts, for the Node.js version it runs.
# The database, uploads, extensions and .env are never touched once there.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' https://registry.npmjs.org/directus) ||
    fail "npm can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta")
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
version="${version#v}"
[ "$version" = latest ] && version="$latest"
jq -e --arg v "$version" '.versions[$v]' <<<"$meta" > /dev/null ||
    fail "Directus has no version $version. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."
major=${version%%.*}
[ "$major" -ge 11 ] || fail "This egg runs Directus 11 and newer. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."

# sqlite3 6 needs a newer C library than Raptor's Node.js images (Debian 12)
# have: 5.1.7 works with Directus the same way.
jq -n --arg v "$version" '{private: true, name: "directus-server", dependencies: {directus: $v, sqlite3: "5.1.7"}, overrides: {sqlite3: "5.1.7"}}' > package.json
rm -f package-lock.json

mkdir -p data uploads extensions
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    secret=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
    cat > .env <<ENV
# Directus's settings: https://directus.io/docs/configuration/general
# The port, the public URL and usage reports are set by the server's
# settings. Restart the server after changing this file.
DB_CLIENT="sqlite3"
DB_FILENAME="./data/database.db"
SECRET="$secret"
STORAGE_LOCATIONS="local"
STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT="./uploads"
EXTENSIONS_PATH="./extensions"
WEBSOCKETS_ENABLED=true
ENV
fi
echo "Set up Directus $version. It is downloaded when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Directus version to install, such as 12.6.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin email
variables.description: The email address the admin signs in with, used for the account made on the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, needed for the first start. Change it later in the admin app.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The full address people open Directus at, with http or https in front, for links and emails. Empty leaves it unset.

variables.name: Usage reports
variables.description: Send anonymous usage statistics to Directus's developers.
